attributes.description: FinOps visibility into AI, Machine Learning, Inference API, and Agent Builder billing and model compute across deployments.

params.markdown:
# AI & Machine Learning FinOps
Tracks dedicated ML node, Inference API, EIS, and Agent Builder billing alongside trained model and inference endpoint activity harvested by `chargeback.usage`.

query.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_cluster_cost
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL
| EVAL sku_l = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(sku, "")), ct_l = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(cost_type, ""))
| WHERE NOT (sku_l LIKE "*synthetic*") AND (ct_l IN ("ml", "inference", "ml-vcu", "agent-builder") OR sku_l LIKE "*.es.ml.*" OR sku_l LIKE "*ml-vcu*" OR sku_l LIKE "*ml.ecu*" OR sku_l LIKE "*ml_ecu*" OR sku_l LIKE "*ml.vcu*" OR sku_l LIKE "*ml_inference*" OR sku_l LIKE "*inference*" OR sku_l LIKE "*llm*" OR sku_l LIKE "*agent-builder*" OR sku_l LIKE "*.eis*") 
| EVAL ts = @timestamp, deployment = CASE(deployment_id IS NULL, COALESCE(deployment_name, "unknown"), CONCAT(COALESCE(deployment_name, deployment_id), " (", LEFT(deployment_id, 6), ")"))
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, ess.billing.deployment_type IN ("onprem", "ece", "eck") OR cloud.provider == "onprem", false), cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)), currency_unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit)), null), CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR"), COALESCE(CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), "EUR"))
| STATS `Normalized cost` = ROUND(SUM(total_chargeable_units * rate), 2) BY ts, deployment
| RENAME ts AS `@timestamp`
| SORT `@timestamp` ASC
| LIMIT 10000

query.esql:
FROM chargeback_lookup.cluster_ai_model_contribution
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND model_id IS NOT NULL
| EVAL ts = @timestamp, ck = composite_key::keyword, ai_dep_id = deployment_id, ai_dep_name = deployment_name
| DROP composite_key, deployment_id, deployment_name, deployment_group, @timestamp
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.billing_enrichment ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| EVAL is_onprem_row = COALESCE(is_onprem, false), ai_pool_units = COALESCE(ai_chargeable_units, 0.0)
| EVAL deployment = COALESCE(ai_dep_name, deployment_name, ai_dep_id, deployment_id, "unknown")
| EVAL cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| DROP config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_currency ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol, cloud_sym_unit = conf_currency_unit
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_currency_symbol, conf_currency_unit
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(is_onprem_row, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL onprem_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, onprem_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| DROP config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_currency ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL onprem_sym = conf_currency_symbol, onprem_sym_unit = conf_currency_unit
| DROP onprem_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_currency_symbol, conf_currency_unit
| EVAL _c_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), _c_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)), null), _o_has_row = (onprem_rate IS NOT NULL), _o_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_unit)), null), _o_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)), null)
| EVAL _c_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0 AND (_c_sym_u IS NULL OR _c_sym_u == COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR")), TRIM(cloud_sym), null), _o_eff_u = COALESCE(_o_unit, _c_unit, "EUR")
| EVAL _o_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym)) > 0 AND (_o_sym_u IS NULL OR _o_sym_u == _o_eff_u), TRIM(onprem_sym), null), rate = CASE(is_onprem_row, COALESCE(onprem_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)), unit = CASE(is_onprem_row, _o_eff_u, COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR"))
| EVAL _def_sym = CASE(unit == "USD", "$", unit == "GBP", "£", unit == "ZAR", "R", "€")
| EVAL sym = CASE(is_onprem_row, CASE(_o_sym IS NOT NULL, _o_sym, _o_has_row AND _o_unit IS NULL AND _c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _c_sym IS NOT NULL AND _c_unit == unit, _c_sym, _def_sym), CASE(_c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _def_sym))
| EVAL Currency = CONCAT(sym, " ", unit)
| STATS day_inf = SUM(TO_LONG(COALESCE(inference_count, 0))),
        day_ms = SUM(TO_LONG(COALESCE(total_inference_time_ms, 0))),
        day_avg_ms = AVG(TO_DOUBLE(COALESCE(average_inference_time_ms, 0.0)))
  BY ck, deployment, model_id, task_type, Currency, ai_pool_units, rate
| INLINE STATS dep_tot_ms = SUM(day_ms), dep_tot_inf = SUM(day_inf), dep_models = COUNT(*) BY ck
| EVAL model_share = CASE(dep_tot_ms > 0, TO_DOUBLE(day_ms) / TO_DOUBLE(dep_tot_ms), dep_tot_inf > 0, TO_DOUBLE(day_inf) / TO_DOUBLE(dep_tot_inf), dep_models > 0, 1.0 / TO_DOUBLE(dep_models), 0.0)
| EVAL row_cost = ai_pool_units * rate * model_share
| STATS `Inferences` = SUM(day_inf), s_ms = SUM(day_ms), a_ms = AVG(day_avg_ms), `Total Compute (ms)` = SUM(day_ms), `Attributed Cost` = ROUND(SUM(row_cost), 2) BY deployment, model_id, task_type, Currency
| EVAL `Avg Latency (ms)` = ROUND(CASE(`Inferences` > 0, TO_DOUBLE(s_ms) / TO_DOUBLE(`Inferences`), a_ms), 2)
| RENAME deployment AS `Deployment`, model_id AS `Model ID`, task_type AS `Task Type`
| KEEP `Deployment`, `Model ID`, `Task Type`, `Currency`, `Inferences`, `Avg Latency (ms)`, `Total Compute (ms)`, `Attributed Cost`
| SORT `Attributed Cost` DESC, `Total Compute (ms)` DESC, `Inferences` DESC
| LIMIT 5000
